desc: Wilson Combat Rifle Ammo features High quality, USA made brass cases, bullets and other components, Clean burning, low-flash powders for preserved night vision and reduced firearm maintenance, and Rigid taper crimping and post-manufacture tumble polishing enhance feed reliability and extraction. Enhanced velocity loadings tailored to appropriate bullet construction for controlled expansion and deep penetration tested in real firearms, not test barrels. 100% produced and hand-inspected at their facility in Berryville, AR.
